title: 第2799章 你不配出手阻拦第2798章 真长脸以一敌七
content_zh:
在这半个多时辰里，周阳杀了足足四个钦天剑宗的弟子，身上沾染满了血迹。
而他自身在搏杀的过程中也有所损伤。
被一个钦天剑宗的弟子接连割伤手臂跟大腿。
这两道伤势其实并不是特别的重，但问题是周围的那些钦天剑宗弟子就跟鬣狗一般，不停地在旁边施加压力，骚扰。
这不仅让周阳无法停下来好好地疗伤不说，还在激烈的活动之中失血越来越多，甚至隐隐有些影响周阳的战斗力了。
以目前这样的情况看来。
周阳最多是还坚持个两炷香的时间，这绝对是极限了。
不过即便如此，周阳这也属于相当优秀的了。
在数倍于自己的敌人面前能够斩杀四人还坚持这么久，可见周阳的修为并非是花架子，而是有真才实学的。
有江若尘当年的风范。
“周阳师侄没给我们尘光圣地丢脸啊，坚持了这么久，这样的战斗力都快赶上当初的你了吧若尘师弟。”
屠穹藏在暗处看着，瞧见周阳如此厉害，他是高兴的不行。
江若尘这个做师傅的那就更不用说了。
“周阳这小子的确没有辜负栽培，不过看局势，他应该也快到极限了，再看看吧，适当的时候可以出手了。”
江若尘的目的是为了磨炼周阳，顺便也看看周阳的心性如何。
想要在修行界有所成，强大的内心是必不可少的。
只有拥有一颗勇往直前的心，才能有面对一切风浪的勇气。
不经历这些风浪，哪怕是有再高的天资，这辈子的成长高度都是有限的，不会有太大的作为。
而眼下周阳面对如此巨大的压力依旧是在硬抗，足以证明他的道心是极为坚定的，并且自身的本事也不小。
考验的差不多，他们这些当师傅的肯定可以出手相助了。

“好。”
屠穹高兴地应下。
而与此同时，眼见过去了这么久的时间，周阳还没有被拿下，钦天剑宗的大长老有些失去耐心了。
他当时没有选择亲自出手，也是为了看看周阳到底有多大的能耐。
这决定了他将会怎样对付周阳。
可如今这么久的时间过去，自己这边还被反杀了四个弟子都没能将周阳拿下，这让他脸面有些挂不住。
他钦天剑宗好歹也是一足以对比帝朝级别势力的宗门。
门内弟子联手连个散修都没有拿下，这若是传出去，对他们宗门的影响能有多大？
“哼，真是一群废物！”
大长老冷哼一声，随即目光再度落在了周阳一行人的身上，道：“周山南，老夫是真没想到啊，你竟然有如此大的能耐，真是个好苗子。”
“老夫再给你最后一次机会，现在跪下，拜我为师，可留一命，若是再负隅顽抗，老夫当真留你不得。”
大长老话语落下之际，眼神一下就眯了起来，杀意疯狂地迸发出来。
在这一刻，这大长老是真的动了极致的杀意的。
因为周阳表现的越是不凡，对他来说潜在的威胁也就越大，若是不能为自己所用，那何不杀掉？
永绝后患！
“老狗，别说最后一次了，你就是再问一万次，小爷还是同样的回答，想做我的师傅，你不配！”
大长老已经是彻底的失去了耐心，可周阳的态度却依旧是无比的强硬。
没有丝毫犹豫的就回绝了。
大长老气坏了。
content_en:
In more than half an hour, Zhou Yang killed four disciples of the Qintian Sword Sect, and his body was stained with blood.
And he himself was injured in the process of fighting.
His arms and thighs were cut one after another by a disciple of the Qintian Sword Sect.
The two injuries were not particularly serious, but the problem was that the surrounding Qintian Sword Sect disciples were like hyenas, constantly exerting pressure and harassment.
This not only made it impossible for Zhou Yang to stop and heal his injuries, but he also lost more and more blood during the intense activities, which even vaguely affected Zhou Yang's combat effectiveness.
Judging from the current situation.
Zhou Yang could hold on for at most two sticks of incense, which was definitely his limit.
But even so, Zhou Yang is still quite outstanding.
Being able to kill four people for so long in the face of enemies several times his own shows that Zhou Yang's cultivation is not just a show, but one with real talent and learning.
He has Jiang Ruochen's demeanor back then.
"Senior nephew Zhou Yang has not embarrassed our Chenguang Holy Land. After persisting for so long, your fighting power has almost caught up with what you were back then, right? Junior Brother Ruochen."
Tu Qiong hid in the dark and watched. He was very happy to see Zhou Yang being so powerful.
Not to mention Jiang Ruochen as a master.
"This kid Zhou Yang has indeed lived up to his cultivation, but judging from the situation, he should be reaching his limit. Let's wait and see. We can take action when the time is right."
Jiang Ruochen's purpose was to temper Zhou Yang, and also to see what Zhou Yang's character was.
If you want to succeed in the spiritual world, a strong heart is essential.
Only by having a courageous heart can you have the courage to face all storms.
If you don't experience these storms, no matter how talented you are, your growth in this life will be limited and you won't achieve much.
And now Zhou Yang is still resisting such huge pressure, which proves that his Taoist heart is extremely firm and his own ability is not small.
The test is almost over, and they, the masters, can definitely help.
"Okay."
Tu Qiong happily agreed.
At the same time, seeing that so much time had passed and Zhou Yang had not been captured yet, the great elder of the Qintian Sword Sect lost his patience.
He didn't choose to take action personally at that time because he wanted to see how capable Zhou Yang was.
This determines how he will deal with Zhou Yang.
But now that so much time has passed, four disciples on his side have been counterattacked and failed to capture Zhou Yang, which makes him feel embarrassed.
After all, his Qintian Sword Sect was a sect that could compare with the power of the imperial dynasty.
The disciples in the sect joined forces and couldn't even capture a single cultivator. If word of this spread, how much impact would it have on their sect?
"Humph, what a bunch of trash!"
The great elder snorted coldly, and then his eyes fell on Zhou Yang and his group again, saying: "Zhou Shannan, I really didn't expect that you have such great abilities. You are such a good prospect."
"I will give you one last chance. Kneel down now and accept me as your master. You can save your life. If you continue to resist, I will not let you live."
When the great elder finished speaking, his eyes suddenly narrowed, and murderous intent burst out crazily.
At this moment, the great elder really had the ultimate murderous intention.
Because the more extraordinary Zhou Yang behaves, the greater the potential threat to him. If he can't be used by himself, why not kill him?
Avoid future troubles forever!
"Old dog, don't talk about the last time. Even if you ask ten thousand times, I still give the same answer. You are not worthy to be my master!"
The great elder had completely lost his patience, but Zhou Yang's attitude was still extremely tough.
He refused without any hesitation.
The great elder was furious.
